purpose: Teach: 恐るべき/逆行/あの世/極意/陳腐/囚われ/円満/時代遅れ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは仕事で恐るべき集中力を発揮されるのよ
lines.en: Sho — your father has this remarkable ability to focus completely when it comes to work.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Slow, thoughtful pacing. A quiet pride in the words. Soft, almost nostalgic — she's noticing something she loves without saying it directly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの言うことに逆行しないようにするね
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to make sure I don't go against what Dad says.
lines.style: Sincere and earnest, not performing obedience. Soft attack. Simple, genuine — a child trying to do the right thing. Slight upward lilt at the end, seeking approval without asking for it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんがあの世から見守って下さってるわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather is watching over us from above.
lines.style: Tender and certain, not sad. Gentle conviction. Spoken like a comfort she's offering herself as much as him. Warm breath on the words. A private belief made into reassurance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが料理の極意を教えて下さるそうだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad says he's going to teach me the real secrets of cooking.
lines.style: Bright, eager anticipation. Quick attack. Bouncing slightly in the voice — this is something important he's been told. Pride that Dad chose him. Small, genuine excitement, not performed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、陳腐な感想にならないよう自分の言葉で話してね
lines.en: Sho, try to say things in your own words — not what sounds nice or polished.
lines.style: Gentle correction, not sharp. Warm but clear. She's teaching, not criticizing. Steady pacing. A mother's direction delivered with patience and genuine care for his growth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、過去に囚われてるとお父さんに言われたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me I'm stuck thinking about the past.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly wounded underneath. Quiet voice. Processing something Dad said — not complaining, but turning it over. Soft at the end, like he's admitting something that bothered him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お家は円満が一番ね
lines.en: Sho, a harmonious home is what matters most.
lines.style: Tender reassurance, settling something. Quiet warmth. Not urgent — this is a truth she's giving him to hold. Slow, steady breathing in the words. Almost like she's reminding herself as much as him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが「時代遅れな考え」を改められたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad actually changed his old-fashioned way of thinking.
lines.style: Quiet delight and surprise in the voice. Soft start. This is a discovery he's making — not boasting, just noticing something good. Slight warmth at the end, like he's proud of his father.
